sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.183 - Dev

  • Quick Import / Third-Party Editor Fix: Stopped MV's globally loaded CodeMirror stylesheet from bleeding a white background into other plugins' code editors (e.g. Code2Bricks Quick Import). MV now neutralizes the shared editor defaults so foreign editors keep their own dark theme, while MV's own editors stay dark.
  • Settings Redesign: Replaced the Settings tab row with a left icon-rail navigation (General, Updates & License, Mimam's Bar, CSS Studio, Modules, Media Studio), so every section is reachable and the panel scales cleanly.
  • Viewport Range Polish: Tidied the viewport range card alignment with left-aligned Min/Max labels and inputs.

v1.3.182 - Dev

  • Settings Tabs Reachable: The Settings tab row now wraps to multiple rows so all six tabs (including Modules and Media Studio) stay reachable in the narrow panel instead of being clipped off the right edge.
  • Viewport Range Restyle: Rebuilt the General Settings viewport range as a lighter grouped card with the Min/Max fields using MV's dark input styling and no native number spinners, fixing the white input boxes.

v1.3.181 - Dev

  • Bricks Editor Safety Fix: Widened the Bricks/CodeMirror dark-editor safety rule to cover any code editor inside the Bricks builder (including third-party dialogs such as Code2Bricks Quick Import), not just Bricks' own Custom CSS/Advanced CSS panels.
  • Viewport Inputs Fix: General Settings Min/Max viewport number fields now use MV's dark input styling instead of falling back to native white browser styling.
  • Settings Reorganization: Split the Settings tabs from 4 to 6: General, Updates & License, Mimam's Bar, CSS Studio, Modules, and a new Media Studio tab. Update feed/channel/license/Release Manager moved out of General into their own tab, and Media Studio's runtime/folder-migration tools moved out of Modules into their own tab.

v1.3.180 - Dev

  • Release Manager Layout: Release rows now give title/meta and Download ZIP/Rollback actions their own full-width rows, with quieter status pills that read as labels instead of buttons.
  • Viewport Settings: General Settings viewport Min/Max controls now appear as one related viewport range block.
  • Bricks Editor Safety: Scoped MV Studio input styling back to MV-owned surfaces so Bricks Custom CSS and Advanced CSS editors keep their dark editor backgrounds.
  • Mimam's Bar Settings: Auto-close preference now persists after refresh and before the Bar runtime is mounted.

v1.3.179 - Dev

  • Release Manager Polish: Fixed the empty Release Manager state so it no longer renders a stray numeric zero before release history is loaded.
  • Clearer Package Action: Renamed Package links to Download ZIP and softened release status pills so Installed/Rollback states read as labels, not primary actions.
  • Admin Settings Styling: Restored MV dark input styling for admin-side Settings fields such as License key and update feed fields.

v1.3.178 - Dev

  • Visible Release Manager: Settings now shows the selected-channel Release Manager even before a check has loaded release history.
  • Guarded Rollback: Older selected-channel packages can now be installed from Release Manager after an MV confirmation step. WordPress receives the selected package transient so rollback uses the normal plugin upgrader path and restores activation afterward.
  • Channel Safety: Rollback and update actions remain scoped to the selected channel. Stable and Beta manifests are untouched.

v1.3.177 - Dev

  • Update Feed Hardening: Adds a raw GitHub fallback when the selected channel manifest is blocked through the GitHub API and replaces raw WordPress HTTP errors with a branded, actionable MV message.
  • Release Manager Foundation: Settings can now read channel release history and show package options. Latest updates can install from the selected channel; rollback packages are visible but one-click rollback remains paused until overwrite recovery is hardened.
  • Channel Safety: Development updates remain scoped to the Dev manifest only. Stable and Beta manifests are untouched.

v1.3.176 - Dev

  • Transient Caching for Collections: Implemented ve_media_collections_list Transient caching inside MediaCollectionManager to eliminate N+1 term database queries, significantly optimizing REST API performance. Hooked WordPress taxonomy actions to invalidate cache dynamically.
  • SVG Intrinsic Sizing Fallback: Added min-width/height fallbacks to prevent raw SVG files lacking viewBox or dimensions from collapsing inside masonry cards.

v1.3.175 - Dev

  • SVG Previews Fix: Forces SVG assets to load the original attachment source URL instead of generated thumbnail sizes, bypassing blank placeholder stripes.

v1.3.170-174 - Dev

  • Content Studio Expansion: Added a split-pane content and SEO editor, live readability/headings checklists, SERP previews, and inline dialogs.
  • Bricks Builder Double-Click Picker: Media items now support double-click insertion within Bricks, with click-detail intervals guarding event reliability.
  • CodeMirror Isolation: Scoped editor autocomplete hints strictly to the CSS Studio container to prevent autocomplete conflict/breakage in other code tools.
